context: Mirror the DuckLake fix: suppress the chained cause when self.token is set (raise ... from None), keeping the redacted message as the sole carrier of the diagnosis; keep the chain for token-free runs so ordinary connection failures stay debuggable.
description: benchbox/platforms/motherduck.py:223-228 redacts the message with _redact_motherduck_token() but still raises 'from e'. The original driver exception carries the unredacted motherduck_token, and Python prints it in the 'direct cause' section of any traceback, so the redaction is undone wherever a traceback is logged (CI output, crash reports). Same defect class as the DuckLake postgres password leak fixed in #1333, which suppresses the cause whenever the adapter holds secret material and keeps the chain otherwise.

preserves.behavior: The existing _redact_motherduck_token() message redaction stays intact
Token-free connection failures keep their chained cause and full driver text

verifications.description: Regression test: a failed MotherDuck connection exposes the token neither in the message nor in __cause__
verifications.expected: all pass; reverting the fix flips the new test to red

work_units.evidence: benchbox/platforms/motherduck.py create_connection(): 'from e' -> 'from None' so the chained cause cannot re-print the unredacted token; comment records why it is unconditional (__init__ guarantees a token)
work_units.summary: Suppress the chained cause when a token is held, mirroring DuckLake's holds_secret_material gate
